description: Production d'électricité is a dataset listed in data.gov.be, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by North Gate II & III - INS (STATBEL - Statistics Belgium). The tables below present the annual gross electricity production per type of producer and per energy source. The production figures are available from 1990 up to and including 2025. Coverage: North Gate II & III - INS (STATBEL - Statistics Belgium). The portal shows the English title as "Electricity production" (machine-translated by the portal). The publisher named on the listing is North Gate II & III - INS (STATBEL - Statistics Belgium). Its keywords include Energie, Energy. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support energy network and generation-capacity studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-data-gov-be.
